name: @lilka/vane
description: Reference implementation of the Entity Event model and framework.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of ['dist', 'dist-test', 'dist-integration']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:integration: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-integration', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc --noEmit && npm run test:types
scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test 'dist-test/test/**/*.test.js'
scripts.test:integration: node -e "if (!process.env.VANE_TEST_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('VANE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required for PostgreSQL integration tests.'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run build:integration && node --test --test-concurrency=1 'dist-integration/test-integration/**/*.test.js'
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm test
